description: The default path for a solo assignment. Save a private concrete offer, not an assignment. Present the returned draft and wait for the person to choose, then record it with respond_quest_offer — accept assigns that exact draft, so do not also call store_quest. If show_quest_offer is available, use it to display the saved draft; its buttons record choices themselves, so do not repeat that write. Uses the same draft fields as store_quest. Existing unresolved offers cannot be overwritten.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

steps.description: 1-10 steps, each an action rather than a vibe, up to 600 characters. Blank steps are rejected.
